title: Visited cells on embedded work tapes
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean-input multi-tape Turing machine with $m$ work tapes, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $y$. Suppose the Boolean tag $b$ marks the boundary of the input-head position of $c$: at position $0$ it is false, and at position $|y|+1$ it is true. For any Boolean word $x$, position $p$ on its input tape, output prefix, time $t$, and work-tape index $i<m$, the cells visited by the head on bank tape $i$ of the virtual-host machine from the corresponding virtual-host configuration through time $t$ are exactly the cells visited by work-tape head $i$ of $M$ from $c$ through time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean tag $b$ satisfying the two boundary implications for $c$'s input-head position
Boolean word $x$ and input-head position $p$ among its $|x|+2$ positions
